policy: Owner decision 2026-10-07: IDENTICAL identity is required across NVIDIA and AMD only; Apple, host and PTX columns are optional. Identity is the stored scored output hash (and complete typed model state when both columns captured it). AMD receipts whose commit differs from the pinned NVIDIA commit are accepted when no *.mojo, bindings/ or python/mojolearn/ file differs between the two commits; the full changed-file list is in report.json.
